title: Recursive Parallel Prefix Scan Using CUDA
author: Lukas Bierling
summary: The article explains how to compute prefix sums efficiently on a GPU using CUDA by dividing the problem into smaller blocks processed in parallel. It uses a recursive approach that calculates local prefix sums, then combines these results by recursively scanning block sums. This method speeds up computation by reducing synchronization needs and leveraging fast shared memory within thread blocks.
